name: Bigaku Yurika & Asuna
source:
There is a prestige school where rich and high-class students enter and Asuna, an ordinary and innocent girl, and Yurika, a super rich student, meet there. Their relationship generates black desire in the school and causes an insane world involving other students....

[From ErogeShop]
